title: Connective derived test sections are ordinary cycles naturally
statement: Choose the shared derived localizations of [def-pc-derived-category]. Let W be a scheme, U an open, E in D(O_W), and K a strictly perfect complex on the localized site over U [def-pc-perfect-complex], with K^i zero for i<0 and E|U isomorphic to QK. For G_K and its raw restriction of [def-sc-picard-ordinary-model-cycles], there exists a simultaneous family of additive equivalences q(t,s,h):P(E,t)≃G_K(t,s), for every scheme T and maps t:T→W, s:T→U and factorization h:s;U.ι=t. Here P and its restriction are [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections]. For every i:T′→T and compatible maps t,t′,s,s′ with i;t=t′ and i;s=s′, applying q to the defined derived restriction of a test section has underlying raw morphism equal to the defined ordinary restriction of its q-coordinate.

proof.text: Use picard_termwise_model_comparison to obtain coherent object isomorphisms a and b and the termwise chain-map restriction equation. This result requires strict perfectness but no vanishing in negative degrees.

The two additive underived functors preserve zero objects, so P_s is zero in negative degrees. Apply connective_single_hom_bijective to obtain the additive localization equivalence from chain maps A_t→P_s to Hom(QA_t,QP_s). Construct the additive equivalence from chain maps to ordinary cycles explicitly by singleObjXSelf.inv followed by the degree-zero component; its inverse is mkHomFromSingle. Compose with conjugation by a and b and the inverse localization equivalence.

Given a derived section, let f be its unique inverse-localization representative under a and b. The termwise comparison gives f′ representing the restricted section with the required ordinary degree-zero restriction. Apply the inverse localization equivalence to the derived restriction equation to recover f′; the explicit cycle equivalence reads its degree-zero component and concludes the required equality.

proof_origin.description: M3 reduction: separate nonconnective termwise object/coherence computation, and prove the connective localization, ordinary-cycle equivalence, and naturality glue.

theorem picard_connective_model_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1}
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (W : Scheme.{v}) (E : schemeDerivedCategory W) (U : W.Opens)
    (K : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ)
    (hK : IsStrictlyPerfect W U K) (hneg : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (K.X i))
    (hE : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v}
      (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj E ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) :
    ∃ q : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W) (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme),
        s ≫ U.ι = t →
          picardDerivedModelSections E t ≃+ picardOrdinaryModelCycles W U K t s,
      ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
        (s : T ⟶ U.toScheme) (s' : T' ⟶ U.toScheme)
        (ht : i ≫ t = t') (hs : i ≫ s = s')
        (hf : s ≫ U.ι = t) (hf' : s' ≫ U.ι = t')
        (ξ : picardDerivedModelSections E t),
        (q t' s' hf' (picardDerivedModelRestriction E i t t' ht ξ)).val =
          picardOrdinaryModelRestriction W U K i t t' s s' ht hs
            (q t s hf ξ).val
